answer: A memory-hard attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to compute sequential latency proofs within tightly bounded epochs. To claim protocol fee nectar, each agent must answer rapid sparrow challenges propagated across an adaptive willow dependency tree. An attacker incurs scarce on-chip SRAM bus bandwidth and physical silicon area per concurrent identity.
